chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Qasim, the exegete, narrated to us, saying: Ahmad ibn al-Hasan al-Husayni narrated to us, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from his father, peace be upon them.

He said: Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon them both) entered to a man who had drowned in the throes of death and was not answering a caller. They said to him: O son of Allah's Messenger, we would love to know how death is and what the state of our companion is. He said: Death is the purifier; it purifies the believers from their sins, so the last pain that afflicts them is an expiation for the last burden that remains upon them, and it purifies the disbelievers from their good deeds, so it is the last delight or comfort that follows them, and it is the last reward for a good deed that is theirs. As for this companion of yours, he has been sieved from sins with a complete sieving, and purified from errors with a complete purification, and he has become clear until he is clean like how a garment is cleaned from filth, and he has become suitable for mingling with us, the Household, in our Home, the Home of Eternity.

key_terms.سَكَرَاتُ الْمَوْتِ: the throes or intoxication of death

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual significance of death as a purifier for believers and disbelievers according to Imam Musa ibn Ja'far?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Ma'ani al-Akhbar*, Imam Musa ibn Ja'far (AS) elucidates death as a divine 'sieve' that purifies believers by expiating residual sins through the final agony, while for disbelievers, it serves as the final consumption of their remaining good deeds. The specific companion described had been so thoroughly cleansed of impurities that he became worthy of intimate association with the Ahl al-Bayt in the eternal abode, highlighting the Shia emphasis on the spiritual status of the righteous in relation to the Imams. This concept underscores the transformative nature of death not merely as an end, but as a critical threshold for spiritual refinement and ultimate recompense.
